milestones.name: Backend Foundation
milestones.goal: Decide on a data store and stand up a dedicated backend API to replace SvelteKit-only server routes.

tasks.description: Decide data store: PostgreSQL/Supabase (relational, RLS) vs Neo4j (graph) vs other, based on how characters/sessions/timelines will actually be queried
Design dedicated backend API surface (routes/contracts) to replace the current SvelteKit server-side form actions

milestones.name: Persistence
milestones.goal: Persist characters and their generated timelines/sessions to the chosen data store.

tasks.description: Design schema for characters and sessions (fields, relations to events/timeline data)
Implement save character/timeline to persistent storage

milestones.name: Accounts
milestones.goal: Add user authentication and tie saved profiles to authenticated users.

tasks.description: Tie saved profiles to the authenticated user (ownership checks; Row-Level Security if the data store is Postgres/Supabase)

milestones.name: Narrative Quality
milestones.goal: Improve the relevance of chosen facts and the coherence of timelines when read in aggregate. Independent of the backend/persistence work; can run in parallel.

tasks.description: Audit fact relevance in current event selection: identify patterns behind irrelevant or low-value events being surfaced
Tune significance/selection scoring for narrative relevance based on the audit findings
Improve aggregate timeline coherence: how selected events read together as a connected narrative, not just individually scored entries
